name: Diophantine equation
description: You are given an equation A * X + B * Y = C , A , B , C are positive integer coefficients, X and Y are variables which can have positive integer values only. Output the number of solutions of this equation and the solutions themselves.
input_specification: The only line of input contains integers A , B and C ( 1 ≤ A , B , C ≤ 1000 ), separated with spaces.
output_specification: In the first line of the output print the number of the solutions N . In the next N lines print the solutions, formatted as " XY ", sorted in ascending order of X , one solution per line.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
